mapper.sql: case when p.stock_qty <= 0 then 'empty' when p.stock_qty < ifnull(#{warnThreshold}, 5) then 'warning' else 'normal' end
mapper.select: select p.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.spec, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, p.purchase_price, p.sale_price, p.stock_qty, p.purchase_time, p.intro, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, (select count(1) from pms_device d where d.product_id = p.product_id) as device_count from pms_product p left join pms_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id left join pms_supplier s on s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id where p.product_id = #{productId}
select max(product_code) from pms_product where product_code like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into pms_product (product_code, product_name, spec, category_id, supplier_id, purchase_price, sale_price, stock_qty, purchase_time, intro, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{productCode}, #{productName}, #{spec}, #{categoryId}, #{supplierId}, #{purchasePrice}, #{salePrice}, #{stockQty}, #{purchaseTime}, #{intro}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update pms_product set stock_qty = #{stockQty}, purchase_price = #{purchasePrice}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, purchase_time = #{purchaseTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where product_id = #{productId}
update pms_product set del_flag = '2' where product_id in #{id}
